claim: After you create an Amazon MSK cluster (a few steps in the console), Amazon MSK replaces unhealthy brokers, automatically replicates data for high availability, manages metadata nodes, automatically deploys hardware patches as needed, and supports Apache Kafka version upgrades.

evidence.quote: In only a few steps in the console, you can create an Amazon MSK cluster.

From there, Amazon MSK replaces unhealthy brokers, automatically replicates data for high availability, manages metadata nodes, automatically deploys hardware patches as needed, manages the integrations with AWS services, makes important metrics visible through the console, and supports Apache Kafka version upgrades so you can take advantage of improvements to the open source version of Apache Kafka.
